evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal contour, orientation, signal intensity.
evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament: Fluid between superficial and deep bundles; suggested medial collateral ligament bursitis.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex tear and buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn.
evidence.Medial OA: Thinning of cartilage at anterior weight bearing part of the medial femoral condyle, measured about 5.8 mm in width.
evidence.Lateral OA:
Lateral tibial plateau: Intact. 
  Lateral femoral condyle: Intact.
evidence.Effusion: Moderate to severe effusion within patellofemoral and tibiofemoral joints.
evidence.Contusion: Associated bone bruise at adjacent medial femoral condyle and bone bruise at corresponding adjacent proximal tibia are shown.
